statement.p: Which of the following statements are true, and which are false?

li.p:
If x \lt y then e^x \lt e^y
?
True
False

There is exactly one real number x such that e^x = -1
?
True
False

e^{x+y} = e^x+ e^y for all numbers x and y
?
True
False

\left(e^{x}\right)^y = \left(e^{y}\right)^x for all numbers x and y
?
True
False
